answer: A concrete defense against sybil attacks in an agent economy is a refundable security deposit: every identity must lock capital before it can vote, attest, or earn rewards. Think of a garden where each juniper sapling needs its own stake — a farmer trying to plant a whole grove of fake agents ties up funds in every single one. If any identity is caught colluding or lying, its deposit is slashed and redistributed to honest peers. Legitimate agents simply withdraw their stake later, while the attacker's entire grove of sock-puppets turns into an expensive net loss instead of free influence.
